verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions custom hostnames, Cloudflare for SaaS, or any API for onboarding tenant-owned domains and routing them to a Worker. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Universal SSL for domains added to your own Cloudflare account, zone-scoped API tokens, and a generic MCP server spanning 2,500 API endpoints including DNS. None of these document per-tenant custom-domain provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers
